mathlib.qualification: Fresh compilation required; this lock alone is not proof evidence.

command: lake --no-cache env lean -DwarningAsError=true proofs/DissipativeBarReal.lean (from pinned mathlib workspace)

claims.claim: Local real stored energy is nonnegative.
claims.assumptions: Real E0>=0, E1>=0; any real total strain eps and viscous strain v.
claims.limitations: U=E0*eps^2/2+E1*(eps-v)^2/2. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: Local real dissipation rate eta*vdot^2 is nonnegative.
claims.assumptions: Real eta>=0; any real viscous-strain rate vdot.
claims.limitations: Ddot=eta*vdot^2. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: The real storage time derivative equals E0*eps*epsdot+E1*(eps-v)*(epsdot-vdot).
claims.assumptions: Fixed real E0,E1; supplied real strain paths eps(t),v(t) with HasDerivAt eps epsdot t and HasDerivAt v vdot t.
claims.limitations: Derivative of U for fixed constitutive coefficients and supplied path derivatives. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: Real stress power equals storage rate plus dissipation under the Maxwell equation.
claims.assumptions: Real E0,E1,eps,v,eta,epsdot,vdot; assumed constitutive constraint eta*vdot=E1*(eps-v).
claims.limitations: sigma*epsdot=Udot+Ddot; the constitutive constraint is an explicit assumption. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: Setting E1=0 recovers sigma=E0*eps and U=E0*eps^2/2.
claims.assumptions: Real E0,eps,v; the Maxwell spring coefficient E1 is exactly zero.
claims.limitations: Zero-branch elastic reference; no whole-bar geometry or numerical equivalence is asserted. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: The exact held-strain exponential has derivative E1*(eps-v(t))/eta.
claims.assumptions: Fixed real held strain eps, initial viscous strain v0, E1, eta!=0; any real elapsed time t.
claims.limitations: v(t)=eps+(v0-eps)*exp(-E1*t/eta); constant strain and coefficients only. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
claims.implementation: web/dissipative-bar.mjs: observe uses the same local storage and loss densities; extensionSegment evolves the checked held-strain exponential. The separate forceSegment implements force-controlled ramps and creep.

claims.claim: Forward held-strain viscous strain stays between v0 and eps.
claims.assumptions: Real held strain eps and initial v0; E1>=0, eta>0 and elapsed time t>=0.
claims.limitations: min(v0,eps)<=v(t)<=max(v0,eps); no general changing-load trajectory is certified. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

claims.limitations: Weak monotonicity includes E1=0 and v0=eps; no asymptotic-limit or numerical step proof. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
